title: Fresh PRE-SOAK qualification and UnoRouter validation
description: Run the canonical fresh qualification sequence for PRE-SOAK: transport identity, runtime E2E, scheduler E2E, fencing, recovery, backup/restore, provider/model matrix, and repo tests. Validate UnoRouter using UNOROUTER_API_KEY only if present in the node environment; never print or persist the secret. Validate the new native UnoRouter route and configured model if MEDIAHUB_UNOROUTER_MODEL is set; otherwise record model-unconfigured without exposing credentials. Qualify ECC, DeepSeek Harness, Stagewise, delx-memory-bun, FreeLLMAPI, Kimi K3 in C, and Colibri where supported. Keep Qwen3.8 cyber model quarantined and excluded from autonomous execution. Preserve context_management.experimental_mode=true. Publish fresh evidence and exact PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL results. Do not start 24h soak and do not claim GOLD.
